## History

When the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) set out to fix up their hall, Joshua Tulk accidentally painted the building bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint order numbers. Despite the catastrophic outcome of his mistake, the local community rallied behind the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and placed the blame entirely on Tulk and his family.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_
